answers.core: An average programmer switching to Godot would expect to have this functionality without resorting to a workaround. This is a basic collection operation that one would be delighted to see on the core ItemList control, or disappointed to find absent... [perhaps enough to submit a PR](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106707).
answers.workaround:
The absence of this feature means code like this is required:

```gdscript
var index: int = add_item(text)
move_item(index, desired_position)
``` 

This uses double the method calls compared to a simpler `insert_item` call, requires allocation of a variable, and makes one's code longer and uglier.

Whereas, you could just be doing this:

```gdscript
insert_item(desired_position, text)
```
